In eye-care mode this area and all overlays share the eye-care green, without harsh white frames.

about.description: All data stays on device; reading progress & notes sync only to your cloud. Feedback welcome.
about.privacy: We do not upload your reading content.
about.productDesc: MJ Nexus Reader is a personal knowledge management app centered on reading, knowledge graphs, and AI assistance. We believe real learning is not just finishing a book, but building your own knowledge network.
about.privacyIntro: We understand privacy matters to you. Here is how we handle your data:
about.dataLocalDesc: All book files, reading progress, notes, highlights, and flashcards are stored locally on your device by default. We never upload any reading content to our servers.
about.dataSyncDesc: If you enable cloud sync, your data will be encrypted and synced to your own cloud storage (e.g., iCloud Drive, WebDAV). Syncing is fully under your control.
about.dataAIDesc: AI Q&A and learning tools may send selected text (e.g., highlighted passages, chapter content) to AI services for processing. Only content you explicitly request is sent.
about.dataBackupDesc: You can export a full backup anytime. If encrypted, backups use AES-256-GCM with a key derived from your password. Keep your password safe — lost passwords cannot be recovered.
about.licenseDesc: MJ Nexus Reader is released under the MIT License, free to use, modify, and distribute.
about.feedbackDesc: Found a bug, have a suggestion, or want to share your experience? We would love to hear from you.
about.copyright: © 2026 MJ Nexus Reader. All rights reserved.
